(46). Subjects performed a 3-day-a-week resistance protocol and supplemented it with 0, 1, or 3 days of aerobic endurance training. Results showed an inverse dose-response relationship between increases in limb girth and aerobic frequency (4.3%, 2.8%, and 1% for the 0-, 1-, and 3-day-a-week conditions). These findings indicate that the frequency of aerobic endurance training should remain low if muscle hypertrophy is the primary desired outcome.
